description: This file defines extension methods for configuring TLS (Transport Layer Security) on connection builders within the Orleans framework, including methods for server and client TLS setup and an internal method for handling certificates without private keys.

classes.name: TlsConnectionBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring TLS on connection builders.

methods.name: UseServerTls
methods.description: Configures the connection builder to use server-side TLS with specified options.

methods.name: UseClientTls
methods.description: Configures the connection builder to use client-side TLS with specified options.

methods.name: ThrowNoPrivateKey
methods.description: Internal method that throws an exception if the provided certificate does not contain a private key.
